title: Television with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antennas -->
  <line x1='40' y1='18' x2='28' y2='4' stroke='#4a90d9' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='18' x2='72' y2='4' stroke='#4a90d9' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='4' r='3' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='4' r='3' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <!-- antennas base join -->
  <rect x='42' y='16' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#6ab0f0'/>
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x='10' y='22' width='80' height='62' rx='10' fill='#e05a4e'/>
  <!-- body highlight edge -->
  <rect x='13' y='25' width='74' height='56' rx='8' fill='#f0786d'/>
  <!-- screen outer frame -->
  <rect x='20' y='30' width='60' height='42' rx='6' fill='#2d1b4e'/>
  <!-- screen inner -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='52' height='34' rx='4' fill='#1a0f33'/>
  <!-- screen glow reflection -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='52' height='34' rx='4' fill='#3b2a6b' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- smiling eyes -->
  <path d='M34 46 Q38 41 42 46' stroke='#7ef0c0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 46 Q62 41 66 46' stroke='#7ef0c0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M36 53 Q50 66 64 53' stroke='#7ef0c0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='54' r='3' fill='#f7c948' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='54' r='3' fill='#f7c948' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- speaker grill dots -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='77' r='2' fill='#c44a3f'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='77' r='2' fill='#c44a3f'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='77' r='2' fill='#c44a3f'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='77' r='2' fill='#c44a3f'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='77' r='2' fill='#c44a3f'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='22' y='84' width='14' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  <rect x='64' y='84' width='14' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4a90d9'/>
</svg>
